description: UVInsDet contains 591 RGB-channel images acquired by a ground-based inspection robot at an operating 220 kV substation. The Ural Federal University deposit labels 1,415 glass and porcelain insulator-string instances with polygon masks in LabelMe format and derived COCO annotations. The article describes daytime, nighttime and varied-weather inspection scenes, including occluded targets and negative examples. Coverage is limited to one substation; its exact location and acquisition dates are not stated in the metadata reviewed. Zenodo offers a public ZIP and CC BY 4.0. These images can train or test an insulator-detection component in a substation inspection simulation or digital-twin workflow. The data do not include measured failures, replacement dates or electric-network power flows, so image recognition alone cannot calibrate reliability. The article reports baseline instance-segmentation models, but their accuracy may not transfer to other camera positions or substation designs. The archive and annotation quality were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: UVInsDet: Visible-Spectrum RGB Images from a Narrow-Angle Ultraviolet Camera for Insulator Detection and Segmentation
